title: Hold a commercial fishing licence
what: Hold a commercial fishing licence (and the shares or endorsements the fishery requires) before taking fish for sale.

sources.title: Fisheries Management Act 1994 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not take fish for sale from waters to which this Act applies unless the person is authorised to do so by a commercial fishing licence.
